# The Applied AI Field Guide

Summary: An open-source design and verification kit for applied-AI engineers, product and workflow owners, service operators, and FDEs. It connects fieldwork, value, engineering, and operations for customer and internal workflows. Select the smallest sufficient mechanism; a model or agent is optional.
License: Apache-2.0
Website: https://davidahmann.github.io/applied-ai-field-guide/

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) before modifying this repository.

## Optional task skills

- Conduct one live engagement: [.agents/skills/run-ai-engagement/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/run-ai-engagement/SKILL.md)
- Qualify a workflow: [.agents/skills/qualify-ai-workflow/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/qualify-ai-workflow/SKILL.md)
- Reframe a contradicted engagement: [.agents/skills/reframe-ai-engagement/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/reframe-ai-engagement/SKILL.md)
- Engineer the value case: [.agents/skills/engineer-ai-value/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/engineer-ai-value/SKILL.md)
- Assess decision-scoped data readiness: [.agents/skills/assess-ai-data-readiness/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/assess-ai-data-readiness/SKILL.md)
- Select the smallest sufficient mechanism: [.agents/skills/select-ai-mechanism/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/select-ai-mechanism/SKILL.md)
- Map enterprise integration seams: [.agents/skills/map-enterprise-integration/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/map-enterprise-integration/SKILL.md)
- Design a production system: [.agents/skills/design-production-ai-system/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/design-production-ai-system/SKILL.md)

- Build release evaluations: [.agents/skills/build-ai-evaluation/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/build-ai-evaluation/SKILL.md)
- Assess a material change: [.agents/skills/assess-ai-change-impact/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/assess-ai-change-impact/SKILL.md)
- Secure reads and actions: [.agents/skills/secure-ai-action-boundary/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/secure-ai-action-boundary/SKILL.md)
- Review production readiness: [.agents/skills/review-ai-production-readiness/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/review-ai-production-readiness/SKILL.md)
- Operate the service: [.agents/skills/operate-ai-service/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/operate-ai-service/SKILL.md)
- Transfer service ownership: [.agents/skills/transfer-ai-service/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/transfer-ai-service/SKILL.md)
- Productize field learning: [.agents/skills/productize-field-learning/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/productize-field-learning/SKILL.md)

Skills are instruction-only routes over the same governed artifacts above. They do not grant runtime tools, authority, approval, or evidence. When a skill uses a business-flow or vertical solution artifact, load only the selected artifact and treat it as a design hypothesis—not customer evidence or release evidence.

The optional local [Applied AI Field Guide plugin](plugins/applied-ai-field-guide/README.md) packages these skills with a private STDIO workspace for engagement continuity. Its local records remain working projections, not organizational systems of record, source authority, approval, authorization, or production evidence.

Safety baseline: Model output does not authorize effects or prove completion. Side-effecting operations require boundary authorization and service-enforced duplicate safety; consequential effects also require source-of-truth verification.

Build order: workflow charter and value case → data-readiness assessment and manifest → intelligence-selection and architecture decisions → domain model → agent system/behavior bundle only when selected → tool contracts and capability manifests → threat model and evaluation → model/agent solution release when applicable, otherwise equivalent target software-release evidence. A tool or data-contract change is incomplete until its exact build or manifest is evaluated and bound into a new release record.

Contribution contract: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
Security reports: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)
Execution safety: Review repository code first; run untrusted contributions only in CI or a disposable environment without secrets.
Validation: `npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm test && git diff --check`
